problems: Cliopatria 'Sultanate of Zanzibar' 1963-1966 is wrong in years (the Sultanate lasted 10 Dec 1963 to 12 Jan 1964; the islands were part of Tanzania from April 1964) and Cliopatria adds Zanzibar to its Tanzania shape only in 1967: the Tanzania dossier (af-08) should include Zanzibar from April 1964.

Cliopatria 'British East Africa' 1961-1968 (2.68 M km2) still contains Kenya, Uganda and Basutoland/Lesotho and overlaps their own shapes in 1963-1968; the british-east-africa dossier should drop them from their independence dates. Kenya, Uganda and Lesotho name it as predecessor.

Cross-dossier mirrors needed in other parts: DR Congo / Zaire (Rwandan and Ugandan occupation 1998-2002/03, Kisangani clashes), Tanzania (Kagera Salient 1978-79, occupation of Uganda 1979, Zanzibar union 1964), Federal Republic of Somalia (Shifta War contest 1963-67), South Africa (occupation of Lesotho 1998-99). The Kenya/Zanzibar coastal strip is recorded on both sides.

New slug people-s-republic-of-zanzibar-and-pemba must not be confused with the existing dossier people-s-republic-of-zanzibar (the Sultanate of 1856-1890); the colour agent should seed the former as a new state.

Page budget exceeded by one shared page for Uganda (Second Congo War, shared with Rwanda and Burundi) and Kenya (Sultanate of Zanzibar, shared with the Zanzibar dossiers); Lesotho used 3 of 5, the others stayed within budget.

Page extracts come through WebFetch's summariser; day-level dates quoted in notes are its extracts (Uganda-Tanzania War was read twice). One page failed: Conquered_Territory (url_not_found, retried once).
